vegas.note: Model = as of Nov 9 (knows about 10 games of results); Vegas = preseason lines scaled to 1,230 per season (Basketball-Reference preseason odds pages, crediting sportsoddshistory.com). Vegas and blend playoff odds come from running their totals through the same season simulator; 'model via converter' does the same with the model's totals, to separate better totals from the conversion to odds.

note_effective_n: Teams in the same season share a schedule and a league, so the 150 team-seasons aren't independent; treat coverage differences of about +/-3 points as noise, and calibration buckets of 20-40 teams as about +/-8-10 points.
